title: Comfort Club Covered-Repair Deductible for Protection Contract Holders
content:
The member deductible on a Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements covered repair is reduced for members who hold an active Harbison protection contract. The test reads the tier of the member's active contract under Harbison Protection Contracts.

## Deductible rule
| Member's active Harbison protection contract | Member deductible on the covered repair |
|---|---|
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | 0.00 USD (the Total Protection deductible) |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | 0.00 USD (the Total Protection deductible) |
| An active protection contract of any other tier | 25.00 USD (the contract-holder deductible) |
| No active protection contract | the reduced deductibles of this rule do not apply |

## Reading the rule
- Only an **active** protection contract counts.
- Among active contracts, the contract's tier decides between 0.00 and 25.00.

## Cases (hypothetical members)
- Holds an active Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract: deductible 0.00.
- Holds an active protection contract of another tier: deductible 25.00.
- Holds a Harbison 12-Year Total Protection contract that is no longer active, and no other: this rule gives no reduced deductible.
